mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above the prior quarter's median triggers a risk-off reaction that compresses equity discount rates, depressing near-term forward returns for the S&P 500 over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above its prior quarter median by at least 25 basis points in the same month
regime_hint: early stage of a tightening cycle
failure_condition: Over 60-day window following the trigger, 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than the 30-day pre-trigger mean (two-tailed t-test, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Persistent declines in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) below the prior 12-month average indicate disinflation, which reduces policy rate expectations and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next month.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL falls continuously for three consecutive months below its 12-month rolling average
failure_condition: In the 60-day window after the trigger, 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 30-day pre-trigger mean (two-tailed t-test, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both industrial production (INDPRO) and home sales (HOUST) above their respective 4-week moving averages signals improving business and consumer confidence, which elevates equity valuations and drives positive 20-day forward S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 4-week moving average AND HOUST > 4-week moving average in the same month
failure_condition: Across 10 such triggered months, the average 20-day forward return is not statistically different from zero (two-tailed t-test, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) accompanied by a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a strengthening labor market, which can lead to short-term equity volatility but ultimately supports higher long-term valuations and positive 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% AND PAYEMS month-over-month decline for two consecutive months
failure_condition: In 5 such regimes over the past decade, the 60-day forward return is not statistically positive (one-tailed t-test, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) followed within one month by a rebound above its prior 3-month average suggests cyclical bottoming, which reduces near-term risk premia and tends to produce positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls for two consecutive months then rises in the third month by at least 2% from the prior low
failure_condition: Over 10 such recovery events, the 20-day forward return is not statistically positive (two-tailed t-test, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in retail sales (implied by HOUST) coinciding with a decline in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 2% suggests a shift toward sustainable demand growth without price pressure, which is associated with positive 5-day forward S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by at least 3% month-over-month AND CPIAUCSL falls for two consecutive months below 2%
failure_condition: In 8 such triggered events, the 5-day forward return is not statistically positive (two-tailed t-test, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged period of declining residential mortgage applications (not directly observable in the provided proxies, but as a regime signal) combined with rising FEDFUNDS rates predicts a risk-off environment that drives negative 20-day forward S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises continuously for 4 months above the prior 8-week average
failure_condition: Across 12 such regimes, the 20-day forward return is not statistically lower than the 30-day pre-trigger mean (two-tailed t-test, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in unemployment (implied by a sharp drop in PAYEMS) without a corresponding decline in UNRATE suggests a labor market shock that raises uncertainty and short-term bearishness, producing negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS falls by at least 10% month-over-month AND UNRATE remains unchanged or rises over the same month
failure_condition: In 7 such events since 2008, the 60-day forward return is not statistically negative (two-tailed t-test, p > 0.05).
